from pathlib import Path
import re
from collections import Counter
root = Path('test')
pat = re.compile(r'\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{15,}\b')
counts = Counter()
locs = {}
for path in root.rglob('*.dart'):
    try:
        text = path.read_text()
    except Exception:
        continue
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        for m in pat.finditer(line):
            name = m.group(0)
            counts[name] += 1
            locs.setdefault(name, (str(path), i, line.strip()))
for name, cnt in counts.most_common(40):
    path, line_no, line = locs[name]
    print(f'{cnt}\t{name}\t{path}:{line_no}\t{line}')
